notes.title: New Features
notes.content:
We are still working hard on this for everyone!
We have plenty of new features planned for you.
Here are some that we just finished. :bienfusurprised:

[h1]Keybinds[/h1]
Keybinds are now available in the settings menu!

[h1]New Game Info Screen[/h1]
A new game info screen that shows you all the controls properly and lets you change them!

[h1]A new minigame![/h1]
Try out fruit frenzy! In this minigame you have to run around the beach and avoid monkeys throwing fruit at you!

[h1]Matchmaking Ban Removed[/h1]
Match making ban has been removed!
Join up again straight away if you want!
But remember you get rewards for finishing no matter what happens!

[h1]Partial Controller Support[/h1]
You can now bind your gamepad, like an xbox controller and once in game can play with just your controller! Make sure you ready up with your controller in games like angry monkey to get the controller version!

[h1]Misc Improvements[/h1]
The usual improvements to server and game!

Thanks to everyone for all the support and feedback! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Features!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we are working hard on this for you!

We have added the following,

[h1]New Tutorial[/h1]
This should help new players setup their name, character, play a simple basketball game and get their first summon done.

[h1]Summoning[/h1]
Summoning lets you get random items and cards by spending party tickets. There is only one summon option currently but we have many different types planned and will be doing special events and updating the summoning options regularly.

[h1]New Characters[/h1]
48 new characteres, try them out!

[h1]Cards[/h1]
Cards give you different effects when you have them equipped.
For instance they could give you bonus points in certain games, or make you move faster in a certain game. You can equip 6 at once. We are working on upgrading both cards and items so they can be combined and upgraded! Stay tuned.

Thanks to everyone for all the support and feedback! ːsteamhappyː
